title: Zeno's Planner Configuration Schema
description: JSON schema for config.json - Zeno's Planner project configuration (quality thresholds, git settings, versioning, and hash configuration). Project name and version are stored in project-overview.json as the single source of truth.

qualityThresholds.description: Quality gates that must be met for gate completion and project progression

securityVulnerabilities.description: Maximum number of security vulnerabilities allowed (must be 0 for production)

lintingErrorRate.description: Maximum linting error rate allowed (0.0 to 1.0, where 0.01 = 1% error rate)

typeCheckingErrors.description: Maximum number of TypeScript type checking errors allowed (must be 0 for strict mode)

hashAlgorithm.description: Cryptographic hash algorithm used for generating entity hashes

hashLength.description: Length of hash strings used for entity identification (in characters)

git.description: Git integration settings for automatic commits, tags, and pushes

autoCommit.description: Automatically commit changes after gate completion or proposal approval

autoTag.description: Automatically create git tags for completed gates and versions

autoPush.description: Automatically push commits and tags to remote repository (requires manual review for safety)

remote.description: Name of the git remote to push to when autoPush is enabled

commitFormat.description: Conventional Commits format specification for automated git commits. Type: feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|chore|ci|build|revert|gate|proposal. Scope (optional): affected part of codebase. Subject: imperative mood, lowercase, no period, max 50 chars. Body (optional): detailed explanation. Version moves to git tags instead of commit message.

commitExamples.description: Example commits following the commitFormat specification for reference

enabled.description: Enable automatic version bumping based on project events

proposalBump.description: Version bump level when proposals are approved and implemented

gateBump.description: Version bump level when gates are completed

lifecycleBump.description: Version bump level for major project lifecycle events (project completion, major refactoring)
